```{r}
summary <- read.csv("results/profile_lrt_summary.csv")
failures <- read.csv("results/profile_lrt_failures.csv")
metadata <- read.csv("results/metadata.csv")
knitr::kable(metadata)
```

## Calibration

```{r}
knitr::kable(summary, digits = 4)
```

The target is the true loading of `x2` in a correctly specified one-factor normal-theory ML model. `mean_T` should be near 1 under the ordinary `chi^2_1` reference; `type1_05` should be near 0.05. This probe is only the interior-parameter baseline for the new C++ scalar/profile-LR surface.

## Failures

```{r}
if (nrow(failures)) {
  knitr::kable(head(failures, 20))
} else {
  cat("No failures recorded.\n")
}
```
